Name: Compact Searchable Shop Menu
Author: mushymato
Description:
A compact and searchable shop menu.

[size=5][b]Inspirations[/b][/size]
There are many shop menu mods out there and this mod is really just a combination of features I personally like, here are the direct inspirations:

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2012]Better Shop Menu[/url]: Grid menu.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13137]Catalogue Filter[/url] - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22379]Continued[/url]: Search box position.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29435]Shop Tabs[/url]: Shop tabs.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11115]Better Crafting[/url]: Bulk purchase count display.
[/list]

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Download and install SMAPI.
[*]Download this mod and install to the Mods folder.
[/list]

[size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]Shop Item Per Row[/font]: Number of items per row when a price must be displayed (e.g. regular shops).
[*][font=Courier New]Dresser Item Per Row[/font]: Number of items per row when there are no prices (e.g. dressers, catalogues).
[*][font=Courier New]Stack Count on Shift+Ctrl[/font]: Number of items to buy when using Shift+Ctrl (vanilla 25).
[*][font=Courier New]Enable Search and Filters[/font]: Enable search box and category tabs (if the shop does not already have side tabs), this setting overrides the following ones.
[*][font=Courier New]Enable Search[/font]: Enable search box.
[*][font=Courier New]Search Box Offset[/font]: Adjust the search box's position (default 0 0).
[*][font=Courier New]Enable Tabs: Categories[/font]: Enable tabs based on item categories.
[*][font=Courier New]Enable Tabs: Detailed Seeds[/font]: Enable separate tabs for crop/tree/bush seeds.
[*][font=Courier New]Enable Tab: Recipes[/font]: Enable separate tab for recipes.
[*][font=Courier New]Enable Tab: Special[/font]: Enable special tab for mod added categories.
[*][font=Courier New]Show Default Tab Icon[/font]: Show an icon for case where the tab has no associated item.
[/list]

[size=5][b]Translations[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]English
[*]Simplified Chinese
[/list]
Additional translations are greatly appreciated. If you would like to get DP for your work, feel free to make a separate mod page.

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Any shops added through content patcher is compatible.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url] implements a completely custom menu, so it takes precedence over this mod for catalogues (as it should).

This mod uses vanilla assets for most of it's UI elements, with exception of the tabs for QiGemShop and LostItem shop which have custom tab graphics created to match those shop's themes.
- Those are loaded from the asset folder of this mod, but you can override it in content patcher by targeting:
- [font=Courier New]mushymato.CompactSearchableShopMenu/tab/QiGemShop[/font] for [font=Courier New]QiGemShop[/font]
- [font=Courier New]mushymato.CompactSearchableShopMenu/tab/LostItems[/font] for [font=Courier New]LostItems[/font]
For mod makers who used a custom shop visual theme, you can include compatibility by loading a custom tab texture to [font=Courier New]mushymato.CompactSearchableShopMenu/tab/<yourShopId>[/font], 16x16 is the recommended size.

The icon used for tab that don't have associated item (i.e. the uncategorized tab) is a 16x16 texture created from [font=Courier New]LooseSprites/Cursors[/font] at [font=Courier New]330,357,7,13[/font]. It can be edited via content patcher by targeting [font=Courier New]mushymato.CompactSearchableShopMenu/icon/default[/font].

Mods can put their items into separate tab by adding context tag with format [font=Courier New]cssm_tab_<special_tab_name>[/font].

[size=4][b]Incompatible Mods[/b][/size]
Since this mod heavily modifies draw related logic on shop menu, it will be incompatible with any mod assuming the vanilla layout. Refer to pinned comment for up to date info about mods known to be incompatible.

[size=4][b]Gamepad[/b][/size]
The grid menu works with gamepads, and you can use LeftShoulder and RightShoulder to switch between category tabs (not rebindable).
To toggle search, press L-stick.

[size=4][b]Android[/b][/size]
No.
